records.issue_text: app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb:71 — add_members accepts an unbounded username list and performs one user lookup plus membership work per entry, enabling oversized requests to generate N+1 database traffic.
records.rationale: The diff shows add_members at line 71 splits usernames by comma and iterates with User.find_by_username for each username, then calls group.add(user). This is indeed N+1 database queries - one lookup per username with no limit on how many usernames can be passed. This is a real performance/DoS concern where an attacker could send thousands of usernames causing excessive database load.
